I'm very sorry for your loss. I understand you need to cancel your husband's subscription.

To cancel the subscription, you'll need to:

  1. Go to the workspace settings by selecting "Settings & members" from the top left dropdown at gamma.app
  2. Click on the "Billing" tab
  3. Select "Cancel subscription" and confirm the cancellation within Stripe

Since this involves a deceased account holder, you may need to speak with a human agent who can assist with the specific circumstances. You can request to speak with a human agent in this conversation if needed.

The subscription will remain active until the current billing period ends after cancellation.

To publish your site to your custom domain liveatthesign.com, you'll need to connect it through Site Settings:

  1. Open your gamma site
  2. Click the three-dot menu (…) in the top-right corner
  3. Select Site Settings
  4. Under Domains, click Add Domain
  5. Enter your custom domain: liveatthesign.com
  6. Choose Automatic Setup (recommended) or Manual DNS Setup

After domain verification, it may take up to 24 hours for your SSL certificate to activate. Once connected, click Publish to push your site live to the new domain.

Hi Joshua,

The offline status you're seeing is likely due to a connection issue between your browser and our servers. Here are several troubleshooting steps to resolve this:

Check Your Connection:

  • Refresh your browser and try again
  • Clear your browser's cache and cookies, then refresh the page
  • Try using an incognito window or different browser

Network Troubleshooting:

  • Test connecting from a different network (like a mobile hotspot) to see if your current network is blocking our servers
  • Temporarily disable your firewall and reload Gamma to test if it's causing the issue

Browser Extensions:

  • Disable browser extensions one by one, as some ad blockers or script managers can interfere with our connection

Antivirus Software:

  • Check if your antivirus software is blocking Gamma and add an exception if needed

If these steps don't resolve the offline status and you still can't export your file, the issue may require further investigation.

content_sources.title: How do paid users update their email address?
What will happen to my existing gammas if I cancel my account to switch my email address?
I want to change my account email address and I'm on a paid subscription
Refund Requests

conversation_parts.body:
To switch from your work email to a personal email and retain all your gammas, follow these steps:

  1. Contact Gamma Support to have your current subscription canceled and receive a prorated refund. This step is necessary to avoid being charged twice when you resubscribe with your new email.
  2. Invite your personal email to your current workspace:
    • Go to Settings & Members > Members and invite your new email address.
  3. Accept the invitation from your personal email inbox and join the workspace.
  4. Transfer access to your gammas:
    • Log in with your old (work) account, open each gamma, click Share, choose Collaborate, and give Full access to your new account. Repeat for every document.
    • Check Gammas > All in the workspace to ensure all presentations are shared.
  5. Make your new email an admin in the workspace settings.
  6. Remove your old (work) account from the workspace only after confirming all permissions and documents are transferred.
  7. Resubscribe to your desired plan using your personal email.

Important: You must have access to both emails during this process. If you lose access to your work email before completing these steps, you may not be able to recover your content. Make sure all permissions are transferred before removing your old account to avoid losing access to your gammas .

For yearly plans: Your subscription renews annually on the same date you upgraded, and any invoice updates you make will reflect on your next yearly renewal.

10 Essential Website Accessibility Requirements for Small Business Success

Website accessibility requirements are no longer optional—they’re legally required and essential for digital marketing success. If you’re a small business owner, ensuring your website is accessible to everyone—including users with disabilities—is a must for reaching wider audiences, avoiding costly lawsuits, and strengthening your brand’s online presence.

In this guide, we’ll break down the top 10 website accessibility requirements your small business must follow to comply with ADA, WCAG, and state-specific laws like California’s Unruh Civil Rights Act.

📌 Table of Contents

  1. What Are Website Accessibility Requirements?
  2. Why Accessibility Matters for Small Businesses
  3. ADA Compliance
  4. WCAG Standards
  5. Section 508 for Government Contractors
  6. California’s Unruh Civil Rights Act
  7. New York Accessibility Laws
  8. How to Audit Your Website
  9. Benefits Beyond Legal Compliance
  10. Work With Experts to Meet Website Accessibility Requirements

1. What Are Website Accessibility Requirements?

Website accessibility requirements are a set of legal and technical standards that ensure people with disabilities can fully access and interact with your website. These include:

  • Text alternatives for non-text content (like images and videos)
  • Keyboard-only navigation
  • Readable fonts and strong color contrast
  • Semantic HTML and screen reader compatibility

Your site must accommodate screen readers, voice navigation, and other assistive technologies. If it doesn’t, your business risks being non-compliant with federal and state laws.

2. Why Accessibility Matters for Small Businesses

Meeting website accessibility requirements is not just a legal obligation—it’s a strategic advantage. Over 1 billion people globally live with a disability, representing a massive market. By ignoring accessibility, you’re unintentionally excluding up to 20% of your potential audience.

Plus, accessible websites rank better on Google. Improved navigation, mobile usability, and faster load times all contribute to better SEO performance.

3. ADA Compliance

The Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) applies to both physical and digital spaces. In 2022, the U.S. Department of Justice confirmed that business websites are considered “places of public accommodation,” making website accessibility requirements a legal necessity for any organization that sells goods or services online.

Failing to comply with ADA requirements can result in lawsuits, legal fees, and brand damage. In 2023 alone, over 4,500 digital accessibility lawsuits were filed in the U.S.

👉 The ADA’s guidelines are reinforced by federal resources such as the ADA National Network , which provides comprehensive information on compliance and best practices

4. WCAG Standards

The Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) are the gold standard for meeting ADA and global accessibility requirements. The latest version, WCAG 2.2, focuses on four core principles:

  • Perceivable: Content must be available to all senses
  • Operable: Users must be able to navigate and interact
  • Understandable: Information and operation must be clear
  • Robust: Content must work with assistive tech

Meeting WCAG success criteria—such as text alternatives, color contrast, and logical structure—is crucial for legal compliance and usability. For detailed technical standards, visit the official W3C Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) to ensure your website meets accessibility requirements.

5. Section 508 for Government Contractors

If your small business serves federal agencies or works as a subcontractor, your website must meet Section 508 standards. These laws apply to digital platforms funded or used by federal entities.

Section 508 directly aligns with WCAG, so following WCAG 2.2 will help you stay compliant with both regulations. To understand government accessibility requirements, the Section 508 website offers key information and helpful tools for vendors and contractors

6. California’s Unruh Civil Rights Act

Even if your business isn’t based in California, targeting or selling to California residents means you must follow the Unruh Civil Rights Act. This law enforces strict website accessibility requirements and opens the door to civil lawsuits for non-compliance.

💡 One accessibility complaint from a California resident can cost your business thousands. Stay protected by designing with accessibility from the beginning.

Suing a website for blocking access that is essential for your work or business is a complex matter and your ability to do so successfully depends heavily on the specific circumstances, the nature of the website, the reasons for the block, and the jurisdiction.

Potential Legal Grounds for a Lawsuit

You may have grounds for a lawsuit under several legal theories:

  • Breach of Contract: If you have a contract (such as a Terms of Service or a specific service agreement) with the website owner that guarantees access for business purposes, and the website blocked you in violation of that agreement, you may have a claim for breach of contract.
  • Tortious Interference: If a third party (someone other than you or the website owner) wrongfully influenced the website to block your access, which interfered with your business, you might have a claim for tortious interference.
  • Discrimination (ADA): If the block is related to a protected characteristic, such as a disability, and the website is considered a "place of public accommodation" under the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), you might have a claim under the ADA. This is particularly relevant if the website's inaccessibility (e.g., to screen readers) prevents disabled individuals from using the service for work.
  • Promissory Estoppel/Reliance: If you reasonably relied on a promise of access to your detriment (e.g., you built your entire business around their platform), and they blocked you without cause, you might have a claim.
  • Unlawful Conduct/Public Officials: If the website is operated by a public official or government entity and the block violates your First Amendment rights (e.g., blocking based on viewpoint), you may be able to sue.

Key Considerations

  • Terms of Service (ToS): Most websites have a ToS or user agreement that grants them broad rights to suspend or terminate accounts at their discretion. Courts often uphold these policies unless they are found to be unconscionable or violate public policy.
  • Demonstrable Harm: To have legal "standing" to sue, you must be able to demonstrate a specific, quantifiable amount of harm or injury resulting from the block (e.g., significant financial losses).
  • Website's Role: Your claim depends on whether the website is acting as a neutral platform (in which case Section 230 of the Communications Decency Act might protect them from liability for user-generated content and good-faith blocking) or a content provider/publisher.
  • Jurisdiction: The laws of the state or country where the website is based, where you are located, or where the harm occurred will determine which laws apply.

Next Steps

  1. Document Everything: Gather all evidence, including screenshots of the block message, copies of the website's ToS, and records of your financial losses.
  2. Consult an Attorney: This is a specialized area of law. You should consult with an attorney who specializes in Internet law, intellectual property litigation, or business litigation to evaluate your specific case and determine the best course of action.
  3. Send a Demand Letter: Your attorney may recommend sending a formal legal notice or demand letter to the website owner outlining your claim and demanding remediation before filing a lawsuit.

To prevent your site from being indexed by search engines, you have two main options:

Option 1: Disable indexing (Pro users)

If you're on a Pro plan and have indexing enabled, you can turn it off:

  1. Click Share at the top of your screen
  2. Under Advanced Settings, toggle off "Make discoverable on the web"

Option 2: Disable your entire site

This removes all public access:

  1. Click the three-dot menu (…) in the top right corner
  2. Select Site Settings
  3. Toggle the Site Enabled option off

Note that only Pro subscribers can have their sites indexed in the first place - Free and Plus users cannot have their sites indexed at all. If you're not on Pro, your site won't be discoverable through search engines anyway.

Email changes aren't natively supported in our system, but there's a workaround process for paid users.

Hi Guillermo,

Thanks for letting me know about your concern.
﻿​﻿
﻿Here's a simple guide to change your Gamma account email:
﻿​

  1. Invite your email address: Login as your old email address and go to Settings & Members > Members. Invite your new email address to the workspace.
  2. Accept the invitation: Once you receive the invitation in your inbox, accept it by signing in with either your email and password or Google.
  3. Transfer access: Using your old account, grant full access to every Gamma presentation you created for the new user. To do this, go into each presentation, click the Share button, select Collaborate, choose Workspace member, and set the permission to Full access.
  4. Assign admin rights: With your old account, make the new user an admin of the workspace.
  5. Remove the old user: After completing these steps, you can login as the new user and remove the old user from the workspace under the Workspace's "Settings & members" > Members tab. You could also delete the old account.

Is there a way to create a template and then generate a presentation from the template with data uploaded from external sources

Yes! You can create templates and generate presentations with external data using our Workspace Templates and Remix features.

Creating Templates:

  1. Click Templates in your dashboard sidebar
  2. Click + Add a gamma
  3. Select an existing Gamma and click Create template
  4. Name your template and click Save copy as template

Generating from Templates with Data:

  1. Select your template from Templates or +New gamma
  2. Choose Remix this template
  3. In the prompt box, paste your CSV data or drag in files
  4. Add instructions for how to use the data
  5. Click Generate

The Remix feature specifically supports pasting CSV data and can fill templates with notes, new content, or external data - perfect for sales pitches, reports, and meeting summaries.

For advanced automation, our Generate API (currently in beta) allows programmatic presentation creation with external data integration, though content structure template support is still being developed.

Got it - DNS issues during domain transfers can definitely cause these security warnings. A few things that commonly help:

Second, if you're using Cloudflare for DNS management, check your SSL/TLS settings - they should be set to "Full (Strict)" to avoid redirect loops, and temporarily set Security Level to "Medium" during verification.

Para configurar una forma de contacto en tu sitio Gamma, puedes crear una página de contacto y agregar botones o enlaces que dirijan a los usuarios a contactarte:

Crear una página de contacto:

  1. Haz clic en "Toggle Pages" en la esquina superior izquierda
  2. Selecciona "+ Add page" para crear una nueva página
  3. Nómbrala "Contacto" o "Contact Us"

Agregar enlaces de contacto:

  1. Escribe /button o /link en cualquier lugar de tu página
  2. En el campo de enlace, puedes agregar:
    • Tu dirección de email (mailto:tuemail@ejemplo.com)
    • Enlaces a formularios externos
    • Números de teléfono (tel:+1234567890)

Agregar al menú de navegación:

  1. Ve a "Site Settings" desde el menú de tres puntos (…)
  2. Habilita la barra de navegación
  3. Haz clic en el ícono "+" para agregar un botón "Contacto" que enlace a tu página de contacto

Recuerda hacer clic en "Publish" para que los cambios sean visibles.

Nota: Gamma no incluye formularios de contacto integrados que envíen emails directamente. Necesitarás usar servicios externos como Google Forms, Typeform, o herramientas similares para capturar leads automáticamente.

content_sources.title: How do collaboration and sharing settings work in Gamma?
Can I publish or disable my Gamma site?

conversation_parts.body:
To protect and make your sites private, you have several options:

Disable Public Access:

  • Click the three-dot menu (…) in the top right corner
  • Select Site Settings
  • Toggle the Site Enabled option off
  • This removes public access while keeping your content editable

Control Sharing Permissions:

  • Click Share at the top right of your screen
  • Set access to No access so users cannot view, comment, or edit
  • For workspace privacy, go to Share > Collaborate > Workspace Members > No access

Password Protection (Pro plans and higher):

  • Click Share at the top of your gamma
  • Under Advanced Settings, toggle Require a password to view on
  • Set your password - only users with the password can access your site

You can re-enable public access anytime by toggling the site back on in Site Settings.

To publish your Gamma site with a GoDaddy domain, you'll need to connect your domain through our site settings.

Steps to connect your GoDaddy domain:

  1. Open your Gamma site and click the three-dot menu (…) in the top right
  2. Select Site Settings → Domains tab
  3. Click Add domain and enter your GoDaddy domain (e.g. www.yourdomain.com)
  4. Choose Manual Setup since you'll need to update DNS records in GoDaddy

In your GoDaddy account:

  • Copy the DNS records provided by Gamma
  • Go to your GoDaddy DNS settings
  • Paste the records into your DNS configuration

Final step:

conversation_parts.body:
You can duplicate the deck and replace the text using a few methods:

Option 1: Copy All Cards

  • Open the original deck and press Cmd + A (Mac) or Ctrl + A (Windows) twice in the filmstrip to select all cards
  • Copy with Cmd + C (Mac) or Ctrl + C (Windows)
  • Create a new gamma and paste with Cmd + V (Mac) or Ctrl + V (Windows)
  • The cards will retain formatting but inherit your new gamma's theme

Option 2: Use Remix Feature

  • Click the three-dot menu (…) on the original deck and select Remix
  • In the prompt box, describe your new content or paste in your text
  • Select Generate to create a new version with your content

Both methods preserve the original design while letting you customize the text content.

• Antivírus bloqueando: Alguns softwares antivírus podem bloquear o Gamma incorretamente. Adicione uma exceção para o Gamma nas configurações do seu antivírus.

• Firewall interferindo: Firewalls podem bloquear requisições para o Gamma. Teste temporariamente desabilitando o firewall ou conectando de uma rede diferente (como hotspot móvel).

• Extensões do navegador: Algumas extensões podem causar problemas de compatibilidade. Teste em uma janela anônima ou desabilite extensões uma por uma.

• Cache corrompido: Limpe o cache e cookies do navegador e recarregue a página.

For your customer-specific product upgrade catalogue, you can use Remix to create personalized presentations at scale.

Start by creating a workspace template from your existing presentation - click the three-dot menu and select "Save copy as template". Name it something like "Product Upgrade Catalogue Template".

Then use Remix to customize each version:

  1. Select your template and click "Remix this template"

This approach lets you maintain one master template while generating customer-specific versions showing only relevant upgrades based on their product history and current features.

conversation_parts.body:
Currently, you cannot add multiple cards at once in an existing Gamma - each card must be added individually.

However, you have two efficient options:

Add cards one by one:

  • Hover between existing cards until a + appears, then click to add blank cards
  • Use the sparkle icon for AI-generated cards based on your existing content

Copy multiple cards from another Gamma:

  • Select multiple cards using Shift+click in the filmstrip
  • Copy with Cmd+C (Mac) or Ctrl+C (Windows)
  • Paste into your existing Gamma with Cmd+V or Ctrl+V

The copy method is fastest if you have existing content elsewhere that fits your needs.

App slowness can have several causes. Here are the most effective troubleshooting steps:

Check for service issues first:

Visit status.gamma.app to see if there are any ongoing outages or incidents affecting performance.

Clear your browser data:

Go to your browser settings and clear cache and cookies, then refresh the page. Corrupted cache files can interfere with loading.

Try a different browser or incognito mode:

Browser extensions may cause compatibility issues. Test in an incognito window or different browser without extensions.

Check your network:

Try connecting from a different network (like a mobile hotspot) to see if your current network or firewall is causing slowdowns.

Disable antivirus temporarily:

Some antivirus software may interfere with our app's performance. Try temporarily disabling it to test.

If these steps don't resolve the slowness, wait a few minutes and try again, as temporary server issues or internet instability might resolve themselves.

Si Agent está bloqueado en tu plan pago, significa que has agotado tus créditos mensuales. En los planes pagos, Agent consume entre 1-20 créditos por sugerencia de IA y 5 créditos por cada tarjeta que crees.

Para resolver esto, puedes comprar créditos adicionales por $6 USD (1,500 créditos). Los créditos se asignan a nivel de usuario y se renuevan automáticamente en la fecha de tu plan mensual.

Mientras tanto, puedes rediseñar diapositivas usando métodos que no requieren créditos:

• Cambiar layouts manualmente: Haz clic en el layout y selecciona uno diferente desde la barra de herramientas

• Smart Layouts: Ve a Insertar > Smart Layouts para aplicar nuevos templates

• Edición manual: Modifica texto, imágenes y formato directamente en las tarjetas

Quando você publica um site no seu domínio personalizado, pode levar até 24 horas para que as mudanças apareçam completamente.

• Propagação DNS: Após configurar o domínio, aguarde pelo menos 24 horas para verificação e ativação dos certificados SSL

  2. Vá para a aba Domínios

Entendo sua situação - você está sendo cobrado pelo plano Pro mas não tem acesso aos recursos. Isso pode acontecer por alguns motivos:

Verificações importantes:

  • Certifique-se de que você é administrador do workspace - apenas admins podem acessar configurações de cobrança
  • Se há múltiplos membros no workspace, você pode estar sendo cobrado por usuários adicionais

Para cancelar sua assinatura:

  1. Acesse "Settings & members" no painel esquerdo
  2. Vá para a aba "Billing"
  3. Clique em "Cancel subscription"
  4. Confirme o cancelamento no Stripe

Sobre reembolso:

Como você está sendo cobrado sem ter acesso aos recursos, você precisará solicitar um reembolso através do nosso suporte humano. Reembolsos não são automáticos e devem ser solicitados diretamente

Para resolver completamente sua situação (cobrança sem acesso + reembolso), você precisará falar com um agente humano que pode examinar sua conta e processar o reembolso se aplicável.

A Gamma oferece reembolsos apenas dentro dos primeiros 7 dias após a assinatura dos planos Plus ou Pro, tanto para opções de cobrança mensal quanto anual, e somente ao entrar em contato com o Suporte ao Cliente.

Você não receberá automaticamente um reembolso se cancelar dentro de 7 dias após a assinatura.
Desde que você tenha contatado o Suporte ao Cliente da Gamma dentro de 7 dias após a assinatura, você receberá um reembolso, mesmo que não respondamos imediatamente à sua mensagem.

A equipe responderá assim que possível.
Você receberá respostas aqui e no itamarpm15@gmail.com.

Question
The customer contacted us to cancel their Pro subscription and address being charged without access to Pro features.

Summary
• Customer wants to cancel a Pro subscription but cannot find the billing option in settings; bot provides alternative navigation steps and direct links.

• Customer reports being charged for Pro plan without access to features; bot explains only workspace admins can manage billing and suggests verifying multiple users causing charges.

• Bot instructs customer to cancel via "Settings & members" > "Billing" > "Cancel subscription" and confirms cancellation through Stripe; reissues that refunds require contacting human support within 7 days of subscription.

• Customer requests human agent; bot initiates transfer and reiterates refund policy applies only if contacted within 7 days post-subscription.

• Bot confirms support team will respond via chat and email (itamarpm15@gmail.com).
